lyrics:
[verse]
A giant ball rolled to Bruno's side,
He stared at it with eyes so wide!
Kiki said, it's your turn now,
Make your move and take a bow!
[chorus]
The ball is in your court, the ball is in your court,
It's your turn now, so give it a thought!
The ball is in your court, the ball is in your court,
Make a choice, don't stop short!
[verse]
It means it's up to you to act,
You've got to choose, and that's a fact,
I did my part, now it's your go,
What will you do? Let me know!
[chorus]
The ball is in your court, the ball is in your court,
It's your turn now, so give it a thought!
The ball is in your court, the ball is in your court,
Take your turn, you're a good sport!
[outro]
So when you've got the final call,
It's in your court, so hit that ball!
